name: SimpleSync
tagline: Simple self-hosted sync for Obsidian: one small server and a plugin.
description:
An easy-to-set-up, self-hostable Obsidian sync server. No CouchDB, no S3 keys, no config files to tune: in Obsidian you enter the server address, name and password, pick a vault and you are done.

Runs as one small Docker container (Go + SQLite) that installs on ZimaOS as a custom app. Includes a web editor, publishing of chosen notes as a public website, multi-vault and member management, version history, trash, scheduled vault backups, safe conflict handling and an MCP server for your AI agent.
